title: Region-Wise Logit Fusion and Utility-Gated Refinement for Brain Metastasis Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2611.13884v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: BraTS-METS 2026 Task 1 evaluates segmentation of brain metastases and postoperative resection cavities on heterogeneous multiparametric MRI, requiring detection of small enhancing foci while preserving the geometry and hierarchy of enhancing tumor (ET), tumor core (TC), whole tumor (WT), and resection cavity (RC). We present COMPASS-METS (Component-Aware Multi-Trainer Probability Assembly with Structured Segmentation), which combines three five-fold nnU-Net configurations into aligned regional probability ensembles. A structured-probability anchor applies region-specific component decisions, TC boundary completion, RC filtering, and hierarchy-preserving conversion. Omitted ET candidates are recovered additively using learned component confidence and deterministic multi-trainer support for ET and its TC/WT parents; a final utility gate admits only disconnected candidates with sufficient lesion-existence and geometry-safety probabilities

translated_title: 用于脑转移瘤分割的区域级Logit融合与效用门控精细化
translated_abstract: BraTS-METS 2026 任务1评估在异构多参数MRI上对脑转移瘤及术后切除腔的分割，要求在检测小的强化病灶的同时，保持强化肿瘤（ET）、肿瘤核心（TC）、全肿瘤（WT）和切除腔（RC）的几何形状与层级结构。我们提出了COMPASS-METS（组件感知的多训练者概率组装与结构化分割），它将三个五折nnU-Net配置组合成对齐的区域概率集成。结构化概率锚点应用区域特定的组件决策、TC边界补全、RC过滤以及保持层级的转换。被遗漏的ET候选区域利用学习到的组件置信度以及针对ET及其TC/WT父区域的确定性多训练者支持进行加性恢复；最终的效用门控仅接受具有足够病灶存在概率和几何安全概率的不连通候选区域。
tldr: 该论文提出COMPASS-METS框架，通过融合多个nnU-Net配置的区域概率集成、结构化概率锚点与效用门控精细化，在保持ET/TC/WT/RC层级结构的同时有效检测脑转移瘤的小强化病灶。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes COMPASS-METS, which fuses region-wise probability ensembles from multiple nnU-Net configurations with a structured-probability anchor and utility-gated refinement to detect small enhancing foci while preserving the ET/TC/WT/RC hierarchy in brain metastasis segmentation.
